name: The Lands of Barovia
note: Positions and land cover read from the regional map at 400 dpi; the art is painted from this data.

pins.name: Old Svalich Road
pins.blurb: The old road through the Svalich Woods, the only way into the valley.
pins.dm: The mists close behind travellers; the road brings the party to the gates.

pins.name: Gates of Barovia (east)
pins.blurb: Two crumbling stone pillars and a rusted iron gate, headless statues to either side.
pins.dm: The gate swings open on its own; the mists keep anyone from turning back.

pins.name: Svalich Woods
pins.blurb: Dark pines press in on the road; wolves howl at dusk.
pins.dm: Wolf and dire wolf encounters on the road; the body with the letter lies here.

pins.name: River Ivlis
pins.blurb: A cold, fast river running down from the falls to the village.

pins.name: Village of Barovia
pins.blurb: A grim village of shuttered houses in the castle's shadow.
pins.dm: Ismark and Ireena, the burgomaster's wake, Death House at the edge of town.

pins.name: River Ivlis Crossroads
pins.blurb: A crossroads by the river with an old gallows.
pins.dm: The gallows sometimes shows a hanged figure that looks like one of the party.

pins.name: Tser Pool Encampment
pins.blurb: A Vistani camp beside a still pool below the falls; fires and music at night.
pins.dm: Madam Eva reads the party's fortune here; the reading sets where the treasures and the ally are.

pins.name: Tser Falls
pins.blurb: A thousand-foot waterfall spanned by a stone bridge on the road to the castle.

pins.name: Black Carriage
pins.blurb: A black carriage waits by the road, its horses standing silent.
pins.dm: Strahd's carriage; it carries invited guests up to the castle.

pins.name: Gates of Barovia (west)
pins.blurb: The western gate of the same kind: pillars, iron and mist.

pins.name: Gates of Ravenloft
pins.blurb: Iron gates and a gatehouse at the foot of the castle's crag.

pins.name: Castle Ravenloft
pins.blurb: The castle of the lord of Barovia, perched on a pillar of rock a thousand feet above the valley.
pins.dm: Strahd's seat. Playable once the castle levels are built.

pins.name: Lake Zarovich
pins.blurb: A wide mountain lake, cold and deep, fished by folk from Vallaki.
pins.dm: Bluto and his rowboat; Arabelle.

pins.name: Mount Baratok
pins.blurb: A snow-capped peak north of Vallaki.

pins.name: Town of Vallaki
pins.blurb: A walled town that keeps the devil at bay with festivals and locked gates.
pins.dm: Baron Vargas, the Wachters, Blinsky, St. Andral's church and the missing bones.

pins.name: Old Bonegrinder
pins.blurb: A windmill on a hill, its sails turning even in still air.
pins.dm: Morgantha and her daughters; the dream pastries.

pins.name: Luna River Crossroads
pins.blurb: Where the road to Krezk meets the Luna River.

pins.name: Argynvostholt
pins.blurb: A ruined mansion of a fallen knightly order.
pins.dm: Revenants of the order; the dragon's skull; the beacon.

pins.name: Raven River Crossroads
pins.blurb: A crossroads on the Raven River, west of Vallaki.

pins.name: Village of Krezk
pins.blurb: A walled village high in the mountains with an abbey above it.
pins.dm: Burgomaster Krezkov, the Abbot and the abbey's residents.

pins.name: Tsolenka Pass
pins.blurb: A high mountain pass guarded by a gate and a bridge over a gorge.
pins.dm: The bridge over the gorge; the roc's nest.

pins.name: Ruins of Berez
pins.blurb: A drowned village in the marsh.
pins.dm: Baba Lysaga's walking hut; the ruined mansion.

pins.name: Van Richten's Tower
pins.blurb: A lone tower on an island in a mountain lake, reached by a causeway.
pins.dm: The monster hunter's tower; Ezmerelda's wagon.

pins.name: The Wizard of Wines
pins.blurb: A winery in the hills that supplies the valley's wine.
pins.dm: Druids and blights hold the winery; the missing gems.

pins.name: The Amber Temple
pins.blurb: A buried temple high in the peaks where dark powers sleep.
pins.dm: Amber sarcophagi and their vestiges; the arcanaloth.

pins.name: Yester Hill
pins.blurb: A hill topped by a circle of standing stones and a crude giant statue.
pins.dm: The druids' ritual; the tree blight.

pins.name: Werewolf Den
pins.blurb: A cave in the mountains where the wolves that walk as men lair.
pins.dm: Kiril's pack; the captured children.
